# Pulse task #2822: Enforce non-overlapping Arrangement clips with canonical overwrite and splitting

Operation: 7617d1a05e3e7a032bf18c0905cff9b1
Assignee: PORTALSURFER (Pulse #1, GitHub ID 41680373)

User explicit global rule: 'Clips should always intersect and override one another. It should be completely impossible to have overlapping clips.' Applies to TOP-LEVEL Arrangement clips sharing one track, including hybrid audio/MIDI occupancy. Clips on different tracks may coincide normally; source audio events/notes inside a clip and DSP tails are distinct musical structures, not authority to outlaw their legitimate overlap. The immediate observed gap is browser Enter sample insertion stacking a new clip above an existing clip. Quantized selected-track Enter is a separate new ticket; this issue establishes the shared invariant rather than patching only that UI route.

Audit actual canonical Project/Track validation and ALL clip mutation paths: browser/file import/Enter, paint, paste/duplicate, individual and grouped drag/drop, trim/stretch/resize, clip conversion/grouping and any relevant session-to-Arrange placement. Reuse #2718/merged334 canonical overwrite/split behavior: newly placed/extended material wins its occupied interval; retained old material before/after remains editable with correct source offsets, event/Warp/loop/fade/gain semantics, stable untouched IDs and bounded new fragment IDs. Fully covered old clips are replaced; adjacency [a,b),[b,c) is valid. Mixed audio/MIDI on a hybrid track must not bypass the invariant. Multiple selected clips moving as one need simultaneous atomic treatment so sequential overwrites cannot erase other selected members (#2803/409 already owns this hazard). Refuse unsupported/capacity/invalid edits BEFORE any canonical/history/media mutation; never hide overlaps in rendering or weaken tests/invariants.

Add authoritative validation at the actual model/transaction boundary so alternate callers or current-format loading cannot silently publish overlapping top-level clip state. Alpha legacy migration/backcompat not required, but preserve current user's files and unsaved projects: do not automatically rewrite existing saved data or silently drop overlapping material on load. Report explicit invalid/refusal behavior with no replacement on failure. Audit existing engine/test fixtures that intentionally layer clips: update only where the new user-requested public model contract truly changes, preserving independent DSP capabilities and meaningful coverage; no broad suppression or fake test green.

This crosses model/commands/UI and interacts with future section reorder2819/425, G grouping2811/417 and bounce2812/418. Obtain read-only architecture/source plan before widespread edits, specify exact ownership and canonical primitive; do not create a generic new editing framework or expose a temporary overlap candidate as success. Full acceptance is all normal entrypoints plus guarded invalid callers, not just Enter. Finite tests: interior 3-way split, both partial edges, full replacement, exact adjacency/no-op, nested/multiple old clips, mixed audio/MIDI, grouped moves, source/PCM/event and fade/Warp preservation, one Undo/Redo/save/reopen, stale/failure/capacity atomicity. Existing334 history remains intact; no reopening its PR.

Source6 is the existing clip/model writer; coordinate one coherent executor and source2 Enter/quantization interface before implementation. Initial task is bounded architecture/audit, not started implementation or global merge hold. LocalCIonly/canonicalPR/frozenhandoffsolemergercloud3; root serialMac/optimized delivery. No app/project manipulation, media rewrite, migrations or hostedCI.
